name: Layout Inspector Mapper
blurb: a region of a screen mapped to its view in a uiautomator dump
intro: Give a point or a rectangle on a screenshot and paste the uiautomator dump of the same screen. It finds the view there (the innermost view under a point, or the view whose bounds overlap the rectangle best by IoU), the clickable view a tap would reach, and ready-to-paste Espresso, UiAutomator and Appium selectors with a uniqueness check.

usage: Give dump as the uiautomator window_dump.xml text, x and y in screenshot pixels, w and h (0 for a point) and shotWidth only if the screenshot is scaled. It returns the matched view (class, id, bounds), the nearest clickable view, its tap coordinates, a table of selectors (resource-id, content-desc, text, XPath) for Espresso, UiAutomator and Appium with how many nodes each matches, the candidate views, and the hierarchy path. Use it to turn 'this button on the screenshot' into a test locator or an adb input tap.
sources: AOSP uiautomator dump / UiAutomator2 window hierarchy XML (bounds as Rect [left,top][right,bottom])
Android Developers: Espresso ViewMatchers; UI Automator BySelector
Appium UiAutomator2 driver locator strategies (id, accessibility id, -android uiautomator, xpath)
Intersection over union for box matching (Everingham et al., PASCAL VOC)
